cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James describes its value proposition to prospective advisors as a combination of an advisor- and client-focused culture together with leading technology, products and solutions, plus a strong balance sheet and commitment to independence, so that advisors 'do not have to choose between culture and capabilities.'
items.quote: At Raymond James, advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities. We offer a unique combination of an adviser and client-focused culture together with leading technologies, products and solutions advisers need to serve clients at a high level. Combined with our strong balance sheet, long-term thinking and commitment to independence, that continues to set Raymond James apart for advisers evaluating alternatives.

items.text: The firm states it does not lead recruiting with the highest check but with culture and capabilities, remaining disciplined on transition assistance and economics, while still offering competitive economics.
items.quote: we don't lead with the highest check. We want to have competitive economics. Certainly, we have to have competitive economics, but we lead with culture and capabilities... we remain disciplined. We've always been disciplined on those transaction assistance -- transition assistance and economics to advisers.

items.text: Raymond James offers payout structures by affiliation model: up to 50% payout for Traditional Employee, 70-80% gross payout for Advisor Select, and 81% to 90% payout for Independent Contractor.
items.quote: Model: Traditional Employee... Up to 50% payout** and full array of competitive employee benefits offerings. ... Model: Advisor Select... 70-80% gross payout** ... Model: Independent Contractor... 81% to 90% payout***.

items.text: The firm offers loans to financial advisors originated as part of its recruiting activities as a form of transition/incentive package.
items.quote: Loans to financial advisors are primarily comprised of loans originated as a part of our recruiting activities.

items.text: The firm notes it would rather recruit advisors one by one so that 100% of transition assistance paid goes to retention of the advisor rather than to a seller, as would occur in an acquisition.
items.quote: we'd much rather recruit one by one, where we know the advisors are a good cultural fit, and 100% of what we pay in transition assistance is going to retention versus the seller.

items.text: Raymond James has designed a compensation structure including competitive pay packages (base salary, incentive bonus, equity compensation), annual ESOP and profit-sharing contributions, 401(k) matching, an employee stock purchase plan at a discount, and non-qualified deferred compensation plans, intended to attract current and prospective associates.
items.quote: Our competitive pay packages include base salary, incentive bonus, and equity compensation programs. Additionally, the firm makes annual contributions to support the retirement goals of each associate through our employee stock ownership plan and our profit-sharing plan, in addition to a matching contribution program for the 401(k)... an employee stock purchase plan that enables them to acquire our common stock at a discount... we also offer various non-qualified deferred compensation plans.

items.text: The firm notes the industry is competitive, with other firms offering guaranteed contracts, upfront payments, and increased compensation, and that Raymond James may offer loans or other incentives to newly recruited financial advisors.
items.quote: other firms are offering guaranteed contracts, upfront payments, and increased compensation. Our financial results may be adversely affected by the costs we incur in connection with any loans or other incentives we may offer to newly recruited financial advisors and other key personnel.

items.text: The firm cites its value proposition of a unique combination of advisor- and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions, plus a strong balance sheet and commitment to independence, as a differentiator for advisors evaluating alternatives, supported by investments such as the private wealth advisor program and expanded alternatives platform.
items.quote: We offer a unique combination of an advisor and client-focused culture, coupled with leading technology and solutions. This value proposition, coupled with our strong balance sheet and commitment to independence, is proving to be a differentiator for advisors evaluating alternatives.

items.text: The firm emphasizes advisor book ownership as part of its employee value proposition ('It's your business. Your brand. Your clients.'), with no quotas or product pushing.
items.quote: True partnership. We've redefined the employee advisor experience, enabled by advisor book ownership. It's your business. Your brand. Your clients... you're free to succeed on your terms – no quotas, no product pushing.

cells.reason: Multiple passages state the firm's value proposition, competitive economics/discipline on transition assistance, payout structures, transition loans, and compensation/benefits packages offered to attract advisors.
